Bundled unmodified CSP ESM build of heic-to 1.6.7 (libheif 1.23.7).

- Project and source: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to/tree/78345a3fcdb4a1d70d513fce2646aeff0127f7ba
- Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.6.7.tgz
- Original file: `package/dist/csp/heic-to.min.js`, renamed to `heic-to.js`.
- License: LGPL-3.0-or-later; see LICENSE and COPYING.GPLv3.
- The decoder runs in a web worker and uses the primary image in multi-image files.

To update, download the pinned npm distribution, verify its integrity against
the npm registry metadata, and replace the build and license together. Keep
this directory separate so users can replace the library independently.
